feeds.title: Viticulture in Ireland
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Daria and this is my blog about establishing a vineyard in the west of Ireland and learning how to harness maritime climate to make wine in tune with climate change. In addition, we also taste and review Irish wines and champaigns.

feeds.title: Irish Liquor Lawyer Blog
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Sean, a former Chief Legal Counsel with the Illinois Liquor Control Commission, and I speak about the legal aspects of the alcohol industry including liquor law and policy in my blog. I excel in bringing simple solutions to difficult problems in heavily regulated industries.

feeds.title: The O'Briens Wine, Beer & Spirits Blog
feeds.description: Our knowledgeable, enthusiastic teams share their knowledge of new wine arrivals, best picks for the season, cocktails, sales, food and wine pairings, and more. O'Brien's Wine, an Irish family-owned business, is the largest Irish family-owned drinks retailer with a range of over 1,000 wines from over 180 wineries worldwide.

feeds.title: Wines Direct Blog
feeds.description: Join us on a mesmerizing journey into the world of Irish wine. From Irish wine industry news to top wine picks, we have covered it all! Wines Direct is an Irish family-owned wine importer that brings you wines that reflect the qualities of people and places from which they come. While offering you great wine, we want you to get closer to the vineyards they come from, so we discover the back story behind every bottle and share it with you.

feeds.title: The Wine Buff Blog
feeds.description: Wine Buff offers News on wines and wine stories from the vineyards to our local Irish Wine shops. We also provide expert advice and tastings on artisan wines for every occasion. The Wine Buff started as a single wine shop in Ireland and has grown and sprouted into a nationwide team that provides exquisite wine to drinkers throughout Ireland.

feeds.title: 64 Wine Blog
feeds.description: Keep in touch with Irish wine, food news, and 64 Wine shop updates and offers. Our wine shop offers wines from small artisan producers, which are full of personality and have been personally tasted and selected by our team. We offer an extensive range of classic, fine, organic, natural, and biodynamic wines.

feeds.title: The Corkscrew Wine Blog
feeds.description: Read all the latest updates from The Corkscrew and the world of wine. Our experts through their experience and tips, assist you in choosing the wine you love. In addition, we also publish guides on how to pick the perfect wines for your wedding or other celebrations. The Corkscrew boasts a huge selection of quality wines that offer individuality and value; thus, we have something to suit everyone's taste in our store.

feeds.title: Wine Ireland Blog
feeds.description: We analyze, suggest, and offer incisive opinions and special viewpoints on Irish wines. We provide our readers with straightforward articles that are engaging and well-informed.

feeds.title: Irish Wine Reviews Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Noel, and I give simple reviews, comparisons, and recommendations of wines readily available in Ireland to help you pick. At IrishWineReviews, we taste and review wines that are available to buy throughout Ireland so that we can recommend the best to you!

feeds.title: The Allotment Wine Co. Blog
feeds.description: We cover everything (and perhaps way more than) you wanted to know about Irish wine but were afraid to ask. The Allotment Wine Company is an Irish-based wine company. There are always new things to share and seasonal preferences that are perfect accompaniments to specific times of the year. There are also frequent offers that come across our path that you'd probably want to hear.

feeds.title: Le Caveau Blog » Wine News
feeds.description: Stay abreast with all the latest news, trends, and offers in the Irish wine market. Set up in 1999, Le Caveau imports artisan wines sourced directly from vineyards worldwide and ships to 32 counties of Ireland. We love, promote, and sell only wines we enjoy drinking ourselves. We hope you enjoy sipping our wines as much as we do.

feeds.title: Dermot's Wine Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Dermot, a Master of Wine, and this is my personal wine blog wherein I chatter about all things wine. I have ample experience in the wine domain and I do my utmost to be fair and responsible in my posts. My posts might not contain the most scientific of stuff, but it sure has the content that you won't regret indulging in!

feeds.title: Mackenway Blog
feeds.description: Receive updates on wine awards, reviews, our company updates, and more. Mackenway has been one of Ireland's leading importers of wine for the last 35 years. They have over 400 wines available for almost every mood, course, or occasion. They serve restaurants and wine shops across all four corners of the country.

feeds.title: Curious Wines Blog
feeds.description: At Curious Wine, we share our passion for the wine world, bringing you the latest wine trends and insights from our expert team. We've been bringing our love for great wine and service to Irish wine lovers since 2008. We are wine importers, retailers, and distributors whose portfolio includes 496 carefully selected wines from 72 regions in 10 countries.
